name: All-Russian Census and the Erasure of Identity (1897) (C0067)

techniques.comment: The denial to Ukrainians of the status of a separate people at the level of official doctrine: imperial scholarship maintained that "The relation of the Little Russian dialect to the Russian language may be likened to the relation between the Slovak dialect and the Czech language… but not to the relation between the Polish, Czech, Serbian, etc. languages, on the one hand, and Russian, on the other"(Citation: Малорусское наречие 1896) – Ukrainian was considered a dialect, not a language. The census worked as the same instrument for dissolving the nation in imperial statistics: "The census of 1897 recorded not nationality but the respondents' native tongue, and since many Ukrainians named Russian as such, there were in fact more ethnic Ukrainians than indicated in the census"(Citation: Національне питання в Україні ХХ – початку ХХІ ст. 2012).
